title: Seacrest Beach 60 Walton Gulfview Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 5 vehicle parking- Short walk to deeded beach access- Short bike ride to The Hub and Rosemary Town Square- Across the street from Gulf- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $40 per day**- Professionally decorated- Grill- 6 adult bikes- 6 Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDetails: This beautiful Seacrest home at 60 Walton Gulfview Drive is located just across from the beach! Be at Rosemary Beach or The Hub in minutes using the home's Low-Speed Vehicle or 6 adult bikes! This 6-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home can comfortably sleep up to 22 guests and includes notable features, including a private pool, spacious balcony and porch, and outdoor grill to maximize your time outdoors and enjoy the Gulf breeze year-round. The entire home is professionally decorated to reflect an updated modern style with coastal touches.The home's kitchen and cozy living area are on the first floor, where you'll find everything you need to entertain guests inside or outside on the screened porch, which doubles as a secondary living area and outdoor kitchen. The main kitchen in the home features designer cabinetry and appliances and seating for 15 at the dining table and breakfast bar. The outdoor dining table can seat 6. The porch also has a grill, sectional, and a flat-screen TV mounted for year-round enjoyment around the pool. There is one guest room on this floor with a king bed and private bathroom attached. The laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer is also on this floor.The second floor has its own living area, complete with a flat-screen TV. This is also where you'll find the remaining guest rooms and another balcony. There are 4 bedrooms with king beds on this floor: the first is the spacious primary suite which includes private balcony access and a bathroom with a bathtub and shower. The next 2 both have private bathrooms. The final guest room is a bunk room plus an additional queen sleeper sofa that is perfect for kids of all ages! The first 2 bunks feature twin-over-queen bunk beds, and the other is a queen-over-queen bed. The last king bedroom is located off the additional living room and shares a bathroom with the bunk room.When you're not enjoying the sun and sand, enjoy the sun and pool in the backyard with a fenced yard surrounding the home. Guests can see it all and do it all at 60 Walton Gulfview Drive, don't miss your chance to book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- 1/2 Bathroom with Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Queen Bunk beds, One Queen-over-Queen Bunk bed and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Please note that new construction has started behind this home.
